maya: Heads-up: 'Pulse' social launch scheduled next Wed 11am PT. Need X + LinkedIn thread schedule, partner kit, and 48h engagement owners. cc @harry @sasha
harry: I can run X posts + quick replies 0-24h. Need hero 1200x675 + square clip + 15s vertical.
sasha: I'll own LinkedIn thread and partner outreach. Can we tighten the benchmark copy to two lines: latency gains + cost delta? Partners want a one-liner.
maya: Draft bullets in Drive: latency SLAs, ~30% token cost avg. Shorten for LI and partner copy (no links).
cj: Assets checklist: hero jpg, 1080 square png, 30s mp4 (16:9), 15s vertical, CTA overlay (Register), alt text, and plain-text captions for partners.
katie: Registration link?
social-bot: Registration URL -> https://redwood.ai/events/pulse-launch?utm_source=social
harry: X plan: 3 posts day-of (announce, stat hook, CTA), nudge at 4pm PT, next-day reminder 9am PT. Pin FAQ with webinar time conversions.
sasha: LI draft: "Pulse: predictable inference latency + measurable cost wins. See our benchmarks + live Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/events/pulse-launch?utm_campaign=pulse_launch&utm_source=linkedin"
cj: Will add stat overlay to 30s clip + export 15s vertical by Tue EOD. Uploading to #marketing-assets when done.
katie: Who handles product questions in comments? I can take product Qs on LI, harry takes customer support replies on X, sasha covers partner mentions.
maya: Playbook: 1) monitor top 15 replies, 2) tag demo leads and route to AE channel, 3) DM high-intent replies with scheduler link, 4) record followups in CRM. Owners: harry (X), sasha (LI), katie (product), cj (assets).
harry: Also recommend seeding to 6 micro-influencers + partner handles. Sasha, can you assemble seed text (no links) for partners?
sasha: On it. Will include partner-friendly copy and alt captions.
social-bot: Reminder: upload final assets to #marketing-assets by 2026-04-07T23:59Z
cj: Uploaded draft assets to Drive: https://drive.google.com/zzz  feedback welcome.
maya: Legal cleared the stat but keep backup copy without stat. Final checklist: assets, captions (X/LI/partner), UTMs, schedule, owners, engagement playbook. Anything missing?
katie: I'll prepare canned replies for top 10 FAQs and share in the doc.
maya: Great  thanks team! :rocket:
